home.hero_subtitle: I'm Ana, digital animator. I make characters, worlds and motion that tell stories.
home.marquee: Character design · 2D animation · Motion · Illustration · Storyboard · Concept art ·
home.about_text: Digital animator focused on character design and expressive movement. I mainly work in 2D, with detours into 3D and motion graphics. I love the crossover between absurd and tender.

about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm Ana, digital animator based somewhere on this planet. I've spent years telling stories at 24 frames per second.
about.bio_text: I started drawing characters in school notebooks and never stopped. I studied digital animation and since then I've been working on personal and commercial projects mixing character design, 2D animation and motion graphics.
about.approach_text: Every project starts with a character. A gesture, a look, a way of walking. Then I build the world around them.
